description: This file defines the PathOutput class responsible for managing file path output formatting, including directory handling and escaping rules, within a build system context.

classes.name: PathOutput
classes.description: A class for outputting file paths with proper escaping and directory formatting.

methods.name: PathOutput
methods.description: Constructor initializing PathOutput with current directory, source root, and escaping mode.

methods.name: WriteFile
methods.description: Writes a SourceFile, OutputFile, or FilePath to an output stream.

methods.name: WriteFiles
methods.description: Writes multiple SourceFiles or OutputFiles separated by spaces.

methods.name: WriteDir
methods.description: Writes a directory path with optional trailing slash.

methods.name: WritePathStr
methods.description: Appends a string to the output stream, considering escaping rules.

methods.name: WriteSourceRelativeString
methods.description: Writes a relative source string, appending to the inverse current directory.
